distribution.narrative: Li et al. (2021) reports repeated detections of Ips grandicollis around Zhuhai, Guangdong since 2016; the 2019 survey found it at two sites. Morphology and COI confirmed identification, and the authors considered the population established and the report the first record in mainland Asia.

host_note: Three I. grandicollis individuals were dissected in the gut-content analysis, but the Results report successful plant amplification and sequencing only for I. calligraphus. Therefore no host is promoted for I. grandicollis from this source.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips grandicollis (Eichhoff, 1868).
